title: ast.symbols response
description: Flat list of symbols extracted from a single source file. All row/column coordinates are 0-based, matching tree-sitter's native Point representation.

kind.description: Lowercase symbol kind. One of: function, method, class, struct, enum, enum_case, field, interface, protocol, type, variable, module, other.

access_level.description: Normalized declaration access level when the grammar exposes one (for example public, private, protected, internal, package, fileprivate, open), otherwise null.

signature.description: Single-line, language-flavored signature (e.g. 'fn parse(input: &str)'). Truncated to 80 chars with an ellipsis.
